subject: CVPR 25 - [COMPANY] & Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I thought there will be a good chance you'll be at CVPR this year - and if
so, I'd love to introduce myself in person. We've been working on projects
w/ Nexar, Motive, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robotics, 1X and Figure AI etc.
developing models for use cases like pick 'n' pack warehouse automation - I
hope we can find time to connect.

A bit of context on Encord - we help 200+ AI teams label data 2x-10x faster
than in-house or first gen tools, resulting in shorter model iteration
cycles & improved model performance. We do this by offering an integrated
platform for data curation, annotation and model evaluation.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives of the
automotive/robotics space? We'll be at the conference Friday (6/13) to
Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to find a time that suits you!

subject: CV Workflows for optical delousing
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Your system's use of stereo vision and laser targeting for delousing is one of the more advanced CV deployments I've seen in aquaculture - real-time inference in a turbulent, low-visibility environment is a serious challenge. 

At Encord, we support teams building high-precision, low-latency CV systems - helping them improve annotation speed, surface failure modes faster, and scale eval workflows as they iterate (FarmWise and Carbon Robotics). We've seen teams hit limits with tools like Voxel51 when accuracy or throughput becomes the bottleneck. 

Would you be up for a 20-min chat? I'd love to hear more about Stingray's approach and share what others in high-noise environments are doing.
